Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și internet
We are seeking an experienced Senior .NET WebForms Developer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise-level web applications using ASP.NET WebForms and the Microsoft .NET Framework. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, strong problem-solving abilities, and leadership skills to mentor junior developers and drive best practices across the development lifecycle.
 Key Responsibilities 
Lead the end-to-end development lifecycle of complex web applications built on ASP.NET WebForms and C#.
Architect scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions, ensuring maintainability and extensibility.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, QA, and project managers to gather requirements and deliver high-quality software.
Mentor and guide junior and mid-level developers, conducting code reviews and sharing best practices.
Develop and optimize SQL Server databases, including complex queries, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.
Implement security standards, authentication, and authorization mechanisms within applications.
Drive modernization efforts by recommending and implementing upgrades, refactoring legacy code, and integrating newer .NET technologies.
Lead troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning for production issues.
Contribute to architectural decisions and technical documentation.
Ensure adherence to Agile/Scrum development processes and continuous integration/deployment workflows.
 Required Skills and Qualifications 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of professional experience developing enterprise applications with ASP.NET WebForms and C#.
Deep expertise in .NET Framework (4.x) and WebForms architecture.
Strong command of SQL Server, including query optimization and database design.
Proficient in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX.
Extensive experience with OOP principles, design patterns, and software architecture best practices.
Familiarity with IIS administration, version control systems (Git, TFS), and Visual Studio.
Proven ability to mentor and lead development teams.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills 
Experience with .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, or Blazor.
Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Familiarity with cloud services, especially Microsoft Azure.
Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
Experience in performance tuning and scalability of high-traffic applications.
Background in Agile and Scrum methodologies, including roles such as Scrum Master or Technical Lead
 About Ascendion: 
Ascendion is transforming the future of technology with AI-driven software engineering.
Our global team accelerates innovation and delivers future-ready solutions for some of the world’s most important industry leaders.
Our applied AI, software engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent transformation capabilities accelerate innovation for Global 2000 clients.
Join us to build transformative experiences, pioneer cutting-edge solutions, and thrive in a vibrant, inclusive culture - powered by AI and driven by bold ideas.
